summary: Short 14 m kerb with a house 8 m away and steep grade.

best_section.where: North kerb of Finney Road, in front of the house at the bend

drivers.seclusion: Mapped dwelling 8 m from the kerb and more homes within 20 m; rules it out.
drivers.access_and_room: Road kerb with a narrow verge; only 14 m long, barely a van length.
drivers.traffic: Suburban through road with cars parked opposite.
drivers.convention: Cars park nearby, but signed no stopping 7-9am and 4-6pm weekdays.

sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy on the north side; shaded much of the day.
